title: Drive MCP running-to-terminal polling with a controlled wait clock
outcome: delegation_mcp_wait_polls_until_terminal_then_fetches_result verifies polling order and terminal result retrieval without requiring the first loopback status round to finish within two physical seconds.
acceptance: The test retains its running->completed script, exact two status calls plus result GET, timedOut=false and exact summary assertions while controlling wait deadline/poll progression.
Production wait budgets and at/past-deadline behavior remain unchanged without retries, ignore or increased timeout; preserve the existing zero-timeout first-status/result control.
